description: Provision a Google Cloud Cloudids CloudIDSEndpoint via Config Connector. Fields mirror the cloudids.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1alpha1 CloudIDSEndpoint spec.

description.description: Immutable. An optional description of the endpoint.

location.description: Immutable. The location for the endpoint.

networkRef.description:
Immutable. Name of the VPC network that is connected
to the IDS endpoint. This can either contain the VPC network name
itself (like "src-net") or the full URL to the network (like "projects/{project_id}/global/networks/src-net"). Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `ComputeNetwork` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `Project` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

severity.description: Immutable. The minimum alert severity level that is reported by the endpoint. Possible values: ["INFORMATIONAL", "LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH", "CRITICAL"].

threatExceptions.description: Configuration for threat IDs excluded from generating alerts. Limit: 99 IDs.
